from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    """A monetary amount mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str = Field(description="The monetary value, including currency symbol if any")
    payer_or_payee: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives; 'Payer' or 'Payee'")
    description: str = Field(description="What the amount is for, e.g., compensation, fine, litigation cost")

class SentencingDetail(BaseModel):
    """A criminal sentencing detail mentioned in the judgment."""
    defendant_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the defendant")
    crime_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the crime")
    sentence_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of sentence, e.g. imprisonment, probation, confiscation")
    sentence_duration: str | None = Field(description="Duration or terms, e.g. '3 years', '5 years'")
    additional_punishment: str | None = Field(description="Additional penalties, e.g. fines, deprivation of political rights")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from one judgment document for matching purposes."""
    document_identifier: str | None = Field(description="Unique label for the document if provided in metadata")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g., 'Civil Second Instance', 'Criminal Judgment'")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number of the judgment")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants or appeal applicants")
    respondents: list[str] = Field(description="Names of respondents or appellees")
    other_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of other involved parties (e.g., defendants, third parties)")
    ruling_category: str | None = Field(description="Broad outcome category, e.g., 'Uphold Original Verdict', 'Dismiss Appeal'")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief text describing the final disposition")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryDetail] = Field(description="List of monetary awards, fines, or costs mentioned")
    criminal_sentences: list[SentencingDetail] = Field(description="List of criminal penalties if applicable")
    unique_facts: list[str] = Field(description="Any other unique fact that aids matching (dates, specific locations, unique entities)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The parsed schema for a single document."""
    document_info: list[DocumentInfo]
